# Templates

Canonical, reusable artifacts the agents fill in rather than re-inventing each time. Owning agents point here from their `Templates & References` section. Edit the template once; every agent inherits the improvement.

| Template | Owner agent | Use in phase |
|---|---|---|
| [`bet-canvas.md`](bet-canvas.md) | CEO | 1 — Strategy & Commercial Framing |
| [`opportunity-assessment.md`](opportunity-assessment.md) | Product Manager | 2 — Discovery & Evidence |
| [`prd.md`](prd.md) | Product Manager | 3 — Product Definition |
| [`roadmap.md`](roadmap.md) | Product Manager | 1–3, ongoing |
| [`gtm-brief.md`](gtm-brief.md) | Growth Strategist (with PM) | 7 — Launch & Growth |
| [`adr.md`](adr.md) | Software Architect | 4 — Architecture |
| [`tech-decision-matrix.md`](tech-decision-matrix.md) | Software Architect / CTO | 4 — Architecture |
| [`vendor-register.md`](vendor-register.md) | CTO | 1 & 4 — vendor/lock-in posture |
| [`model-card.md`](model-card.md) | AI Engineer / LLM Architect | 4–6 — AI work |

These are starting points, not straitjackets. Drop sections that don't apply; never drop the section that captures *why* a decision was made.
